# PosterLab

> Local print-poster workshop for macOS, driven by LLM agents through 23 tools (MCP over stdio, or `poster tool call NAME '{json}'`). Posters are editable vector scenes; every edit is a new revision; results come back as summary + JSON + images.

## Docs
- [README](README.md): build, commands, checks
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules for agents making posters, and how to connect
- Tool `guide`: the full agent playbook (workflow, coordinates, roles, edit operations, taste)

## Tools
- guide, list_briefs, list_styles, list_shape_recipes, list_fonts, list_judges
- create_poster, sketch_variations, remake_poster, list_projects
- describe_poster, edit_poster, poster_history, revert_poster
- view_poster, critique_poster, rank_posters
- export_poster, import_scene, run_study, inspect_study
- open_in_studio, studio_state

## Source
- [Sources/PosterCore/Agent/AgentTools.swift](Sources/PosterCore/Agent/AgentTools.swift): tool implementations
- [Sources/PosterCore/Agent/AgentGuide.swift](Sources/PosterCore/Agent/AgentGuide.swift): guide text and input schemas
- [Sources/PosterCLI/AgentCommand.swift](Sources/PosterCLI/AgentCommand.swift): MCP server and shell interface
